signature.name: VTask.binaryRec
signature.type: {motive : ℕ → Sort u} -> (zero : motive 0) -> (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) -> (n : ℕ) -> motive n

conventions.statement: VTask.binaryRec zero bit 0 = zero; the base case value is returned directly.
conventions.note: Stated as theorem binaryRec_zero in the Mathlib neighborhood.

conventions.statement: VTask.binaryRec zero bit 1 = bit true 0 zero, since 1 = Nat.bit true 0.
conventions.note: Stated as theorem binaryRec_one in the Mathlib neighborhood.

conventions.statement: The unfolding equation at Nat.bit b n requires either n ≠ 0 or b = true; when b = false and n = 0 the input collapses to 0 and the recursion returns zero rather than bit false 0 zero unless bit false 0 zero = zero holds.
conventions.note: Stated as binaryRec_eq's side condition in the Mathlib neighborhood.

facts.statement: example : VTask.binaryRec (0 : ℕ) (fun _ _ acc => 1 + acc) 0 = 0 := by decide

facts.statement: ∀ (motive : ℕ → Sort*) (zero : motive 0) (bit : ∀ b n, motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)), VTask.binaryRec zero bit 0 = zero

facts.statement: ∀ (motive : ℕ → Sort*) (zero : motive 0) (bit : ∀ b n, motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)), VTask.binaryRec zero bit 1 = bit true 0 zero

facts.statement: ∀ (motive : ℕ → Sort*) (zero : motive 0) (bit : ∀ b n, motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) (b : Bool) (n : ℕ), (bit false 0 zero = zero ∨ (n = 0 → b = true)) → VTask.binaryRec zero bit (Nat.bit b n) = bit b n (VTask.binaryRec zero bit n)
